verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a v1 agentic-commerce cart API: a merchant-hosted reverse API built around a PayPalCart object, with validation_issues in responses. It also supports building against the external ACP and UCP specifications. The evidence never shows a published, versioned schema artifact or any conformance or validation tooling; the general sandbox is a testing environment, not a protocol conformance suite. Missing for 10: published machine-readable protocol schema, explicit versioning policy, conformance/validation test tooling, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against a versioned commerce protocol with a published schema and conformance or validation tooling
